description.value: Booster Juice is a Canadian juice-and-smoothie chain with a Victoria location in the Railyards area, serving made-to-order smoothies, fresh-pressed juices, açai bowls, and grab-and-go snacks. The menu is built around whole fruits and vegetables, making it a practical stop for cyclists seeking a quick, nutrient-dense refuel. The unit is takeout-focused with no drive-through.
